title.en: An Act Declaring June 15 of Every Year a Special Nonworking Holiday in the Municipality of Opol, Province of Misamis Oriental, in Commemoration of its Founding Anniversary, to Be Known as Araw Ng Opol

text.en: June 15 of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking holiday in the Municipality of Opol, Province of Misamis Oriental, in commemoration of its founding anniversary, to be known as "Araw ng Opol".
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
